verdicts.reason: In both, the three flavour chips are scattered in a staggered pattern with Blood Orange on its own to the left. The chips run almost to the right edge and don't line up with the text's left edge. The CTA is pushed off-axis to the right, and the bottom third is empty apart from a stray circle. A keeps a strong headline with tight, even spacing. B's headline is smaller, has large uneven gaps above and below the subhead, and its second line runs close to the right margin, so B's hierarchy and rhythm are weaker.
